name: WooCommerce Loyalty Program – Points and Rewards
author: YoOhw Studio

sections.description:
WooCommerce Loyalty Program – Points and Rewards lets you turn occasional buyers into loyal advocates by awarding points, tiers, badges, and discounts—all seamlessly integrated into your existing WooCommerce store. Whether you want to increase repeat purchases, incentivize product reviews, or welcome new subscribers, this plugin gives you the tools to build and manage a full-featured loyalty program without writing a single line of code.

Features

  • Award Points for Actions: Grant points for every $1 spent, product reviews, account registrations, login, and more.
  • Tiered Loyalty Levels: Create Bronze, Silver, Gold (and beyond) tiers with custom point thresholds and exclusive perks.
  • Easy Points Redemption: Let customers redeem points as discounts at checkout or via a “Redeem Points” widget on the cart and checkout pages.
  • Custom Badges & Membership Cards: Automatically issue digital badges and printable membership cards to showcase customer status.
  • Automated Email Notifications: Send customizable emails when customers earn points, reach a new tier, or redeem rewards.
  • Admin Points Log & Reports: View, filter, and export a complete history of all point transactions for each customer.
  • Full WooCommerce Integration: Works out-of-the-box with all products, coupons, and checkout gateways—no conflicts.
  • Translation Ready & Extensible: Built for localization (all strings available in a .pot file) and developers can hook into every action.

Benefits & Use Cases

  • Boost Repeat Purchases: Reward customers for returning, increasing average order value and lifetime customer value.
  • Encourage Engagement: Leverage product reviews and social shares by granting points—turn feedback into growth.
  • Improve Customer Loyalty: Tiers and exclusive perks motivate shoppers to climb the ranks and stay committed to your brand.
  • Drive New Sign-Ups: Offer points for account registration or newsletter subscriptions to grow your audience.
  • Outshine Competitors: A well-structured loyalty program differentiates your store in a crowded eCommerce market.

Enjoy building stronger customer relationships and unlocking new revenue streams with WooCommerce Loyalty Program – Points and Rewards! If you have questions or need help, visit our Support Forum. Any suggestion, please contact us.
sections.installation:
1. Upload Plugin: Upload the loyalty-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Plugin: Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Prerequisites: Ensure that WooCommerce is installed and activated.
sections.faq:
Q: How do customers redeem their points?

A: Customers can redeem their points directly on the Cart or Checkout page. When they have a sufficient points balance, a “Redeem Points” option will appear. They simply select how many points to apply, and the corresponding discount is automatically calculated and applied to their order total.

Q: How do I create or modify loyalty tiers (levels)?

A: Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Loyalty → General. Click Add new to define a new tier, set the minimum points required, and assign a custom badge or label.

Q: How do I change the point-to-currency conversion rate?

A: Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Loyalty → General and set your desired ratio (e.g., 100 points = $5). The plugin automatically recalculates the discount value based on this rate whenever customers redeem points.

Q: Can I import customer point balances?

A: Yes. Use the built-in Points Import/Export tool under WooCommerce → Settings → Loyalty → Tools. You can download a CSV sample file, edit it offline (for bulk adjustments or migrations), then re-upload to sync.

Q: Is Loyalty for WooCommerce translation-ready?

A: Yes. The plugin includes a .pot file in the /languages/ folder. You can translate it using Loco Translate or Poedit. Contributions to translate into other languages are very welcome!
